name: Hotel Valley Ho
positioning: Mid-century modern hotel dating from 1956, with resort-style grounds, two pools and a spa, in walkable Old Town Scottsdale
best_for: Travelers who want mid-century modern design and a pool scene within walking distance of Old Town Scottsdale
Guests wanting a suite with a kitchen or a large wrap-around terrace

facts.text: Hotel Valley Ho has welcomed guests in Old Town Scottsdale since 1956.
The hotel is in a walkable location, steps from Old Town Scottsdale's dining, nightlife and shopping.
Guests can choose rooms in the historic hotel or contemporary rooms in The Tower.
Rooms have a private patio or balcony, floor-to-ceiling glass and Red Flower bath amenities.
Cabana Guest Rooms have an oversized patio near the OH Pool or OHasis Pool, surrounded by greenery and historic architecture.
Tower Suites have a fully appointed kitchen, in-suite laundry and a private balcony with views of Downtown Scottsdale or Camelback Mountain.
The OH Pool has a poolside scene with seasonal entertainment.
The OHasis Pool is set up for leisurely laps and lounging under the palms.
Private daybeds and cabanas can be booked by the pool.
The fitness center is open 24/7 and has Peloton bikes.
Weddings can be held in the courtyard, with dancing on the rooftop or in the historic ballroom.
ZuZu, the hotel restaurant, serves an eclectic menu, bold cocktails and inventive desserts.

highlights.text: The hotel has mid-century modern architecture and lush resort-style grounds.
Studio Guest Rooms have an oversized tub in the middle of the room.
The Tower Loft Suite has a full kitchen and living room upstairs, the bedroom downstairs, and views of Camelback Mountain or Downtown Scottsdale from private patios.
The Hideaway Suite has a living room with a wet bar and a wrap-around terrace.
VH Spa offers treatments such as hot stone massages, antioxidant facials and sauna time with chromotherapy.

considerations.text: Suites such as the Terrace, Hideaway, Tower and Tower Loft Suites require a two-night minimum stay on weekends.
Cabana Guest Rooms require a two-night minimum stay on weekends from March to September.
WhataHotel notes the lively social scene may not suit guests seeking a quiet retreat.
